regions.label: Right DHC
regions.why: Histology scored Right DHC as “maybe”. Probably right, but it was written down without confidence, so anything computed from it carries that.

regions.label: Right RSC
regions.why: Histology says this probe is not in Right RSC, and does not say where it is instead. There is no region label that could honestly go on these channels, so nothing is computed from them.

regions.label: Right ventral hippocampus CA1 (aimed at Right PER)
regions.why: Histology puts this probe in Right ventral hippocampus CA1, not Right PER. The signal is real; the label is not the one on the map, and it is drawn under its own name. A circuit leaves relocated probes out entirely, so this region is grey even though Coupling computes it.
